title: The Atacama Desert: dry skies and observatories
goal: Talk about the Atacama Desert and its observatories, putting one fact in the spotlight with a cleft sentence.
grammar: cleft sentences (known), applied to the Atacama Desert

items: I can put one fact about Atacama in the spotlight with a cleft sentence (*lo que… es…*, *fue… cuando…*, *fue… donde…*).
I can say why the Atacama sky is good for astronomy.
I can use the new words for observatories, constellations and dry land.
